title: Credit risk transfer solutions for the AI infrastructure boom
body_markdown:
## The rapid expansion of AI is driving unprecedented investment in data centers and digital infrastructure — but it is also creating new financial, performance, and political risks across the value chain.


From manufacturers and suppliers to builders and financiers, stakeholders face growing pressure from high capital costs, uncertain returns, and global supply chain complexity.


Marsh helps businesses manage these exposures with tailored risk transfer solutions, including political risk insurance, trade credit insurance, and surety bonds. By supporting access to capital and protecting against downside risk, these solutions can help companies move forward with greater confidence as the AI investment cycle continues to evolve.
